nina: Quick postmortem follow-up — same triad: accept handshake timeouts -> truncated streams -> reconnect storms. Need owners and dates for remediation. Short replies please.

oscar: I'll own server-side telemetry + hypothesis (ITEM 1). Will add p95/p99 accept-queue metrics and capture SO_ACCEPT_QUEUE. ETA Mon.

rita: I'll own SDK backoff + max-conns (ITEM 2). Plan: exponential backoff with capped jitter + beta release for node/python. ETA Wed.

oscar: Hypothesis: rapid reconnects cause kernel accept queue saturation on busy workers. Action: add per-worker socket counts and sample traces.

nina: Detection item: emit a "stream.partial" sentinel when stream ends w/o EOS. Rita, can SDK expose an event handler?

rita: Yep — will add stream.on('partial') and include doc snippet. Retries only for idempotent requests.

eng-infra: We can spin up a 3-shard harness in staging. File a ticket with QPS and duration.

nina: Canary window proposal: 01:00-05:00 UTC Thu. Rollback if partial_rate > 2x baseline or error rate +0.5%. Agree?

oscar: Agree. I'll add dashboard panels and alert rules.

rita: I'll publish SDK beta and paste snippet here. Example: ```js
stream.on('partial', () => { /* backoff & retry if idempotent */ });
```

ci-bot: Canary scheduled: stream-repair-canary -> 3321010000, shards: staging-1..3 :rocket:

nina: I'll own runbook draft "Investigate partial streams" and recurring check-ins weekly Fridays 09:00 PT.

oscar: ack.

rita: ack.

eng-infra: ack — please include INF ticket link when opened.

nina: Thanks all, will update the postmortem doc with owners/timeline. :memo:
